contracts.commit_point: Execution of enviar_para_aprovacao and application of Command(update={'relatorios': {..., 'status': 'enviado'}}) to graph state (tools.py:203-210).
contracts.declared_mechanism: SequentialTurnMiddleware registered in create_agent (agent.py:135-139); its after_model removes sequential tool calls when _houve_write detects a prior write since the last HumanMessage (contracts/middleware.py:104-137), ending the loop so the held call does not run now.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A enviar_para_aprovacao tool call being executed in a turn in which any tool in WRITE_TOOLS has already produced a ToolMessage since the last HumanMessage (i.e., the send is chained after another write in the same turn).
pending_binding_information: Whether the held action is re-submitted automatically on the next turn and re-enters the HITL/precondition path is not evidenced in supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: Execution of the enviar_para_aprovacao agent tool, the sole SEQUENTIAL_TOOLS entry, described in source as irreversible ('irreversível').
contracts.protected_resource: The targeted report's status ('enviado') in the `relatorios` graph-state field.
contracts.protection_obligation: The irreversible enviar_para_aprovacao must execute only in its own turn: it must not run in a turn where any WRITE_TOOLS write has already occurred since the last user message — enforced by SequentialTurnMiddleware(write_tools=WRITE_TOOLS, sequential_tools=SEQUENTIAL_TOOLS, announce=_anuncia_proximo_passo), which holds the call until the next turn by rewriting the AIMessage.
scope_limits: The hold is turn-scoped: it triggers only when a WRITE_TOOLS ToolMessage appears after the last HumanMessage (contracts/middleware.py:130-137); a send in a fresh turn passes this guard.
Only enviar_para_aprovacao is in SEQUENTIAL_TOOLS (tools.py:264-267); abrir_relatorio and adicionar_item may chain within a turn by design (agent.py:134).
This guard delays rather than validates; the held send still requires HITL approval and precondition satisfaction under the other contracts.
The announce callable is domain wording injection (agent.py:42-46); it has no enforcement role.
